name: Gasoline; combusted in equipment
description: Provides an estimated national mix of gasoline combustion equipment in the US, represented by industrial reciprocating engines (uncontrolled).

processDocumentation.timeDescription: Mix year 2017, based on the equipment inventory vintage used in an assessment of stationary combustion technology in the US (Schoeneberger et al. 2022) and related national inventory data.
processDocumentation.geographyDescription: Based on US facility reported data.
processDocumentation.technologyDescription: US average for gasoline combusted in equipment. Mix: 100 percent industrial reciprocating engines (uncontrolled).
processDocumentation.dataSelectionDescription: Single NETL industrial gasoline reciprocating engine unit process (uncontrolled).
processDocumentation.restrictionsDescription: All information can be accessed by everybody.
